title: Periodic fixed-points and their algebraic characteristics in discrete-time Lur'e feedback systems
summary: We study the problem of identifying nontrivial, i.e., nonzero, periodic fixed-points in discrete-time Lur'e feedback systems. Using the circulant matrix constructed from the transfer function of the linear subsystem, whether stable or unstable, we introduce an algebraic framework that allows us to determine when such fixed-points exist. This framework yields a sector bound defined by two vectors, whose slopes correspond to the maximum and minimum positive singular values of the circulant matrix.
